      parent
      Required. {"shape": "earth_default"}, or {"shape": "sphere_uniform", "radius_m", "density_kg_m3", "rotation": {...}} for a uniform body. Details
      earth_orientation.dut1_s
      Optional, Earth only. UT1 minus UTC in seconds, -0.9 to 0.9. Default 0.
      start_epoch
      Required. "YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sss SCALE", SCALE one of UTC, TAI, TT, TDB, GPS.
      duration or end_epoch
      One of them. Seconds, or an ISO 8601 duration such as "P1DT6H"; or an end epoch in the start_epoch format.
      integrator
      Required. {"type": "rk4", "time_step_s": 10} (fixed step) or {"type": "dop853", "rtol": 1e-10, "atol": 1e-6} (adaptive; optional max_step_s, initial_step_s). Details
      output_step_s
      Required. Spacing of rows in plan.csv, independent of the integration step.
      force_model
      Optional; gravity is always on. "gravity_only", or an object with drag, srp, third_body, atmosphere, space_weather. Details
      satellites
      Required. count, mass_kg, cd, cr, area_m2, names or name_prefix, and orbits or pattern. Details
      satellites.orbits[ ]
      One per satellite: "keplerian", "cartesian" or "tle", each able to override mass_kg, cd, cr, area_m2. Details
      satellites.pattern
      Instead of orbits: a Walker constellation or a train. Details
      maneuvers[ ]
      Optional impulsive burns: {"sat", "t_s" or "epoch", "dv_m_s": [a, b, c], "frame": "lvlh" or "inertial"}. Details
